rationale.allowUnresolvedEntityReference: Rejected because it is the existing missing-entity recovery path and could let the parser pass the missing-entity boundary before the diagnostic fails closed.
rationale.allowMissingClassBaseline: Rejected because the fail-closed diagnostic is intentionally isolated from recovery-oriented configuration, even though this option targets missing class baselines rather than missing entity references.
rationale.allowEntityPacketBoundaryTruncation: Rejected because truncation is a continuation-oriented structural mode and should not be combined with a missing-entity diagnostic whose contract is to stop at the missing-entity boundary.
